research_scope: Australian NEW BEV BMW and MINI exact current manufacturer grade/battery/drive configurations, retained/older/announced scopes, and fresh exact dealer advertisements; research-only evidence bundle for Roadmark

timestamp_policy.note: The execution-host filesystem/clock and session clock disagreed. checked_on is the canonical verified date. Any executor_clock_timestamp_unverified is retained solely as raw collection metadata, not a certified UTC retrieval instant. Brochure publication/production applicability, public API effect/order dates, advertised year and formal model year are separate.

BMW.formal_MY: None inferred from publication date, modelDate, dealer headline year or build date
BMW.iX3: NA5 40 and50 named in current June2026 guide; 50 fresh NEW VIN corroborated;40 new-unit candidates failed fresh retrieval; M60 orders2027; G08 separate
BMW.i7: 60 xDrive coming Q4 retained announced; outgoing52EJ and M70 not treated as same battery/charge generation
BMW.i5_Touring: Official technical page retained; current order/new-unit eligibility unresolved; do not substitute sedan or global eDrive40 Touring

MINI.model_year_rule: Keep formal model_year null. Publication/year suffix, applicability month, public-data effect/order dates, advertised dealer year and build/compliance dates are independent concepts.
MINI.battery_and_charging_conflicts: Do not display reconciled usable battery or Countryman E DC maximum as settled facts; see observed_claims.
MINI.stock_scope: 6 of 10 normal configurations have representative current live VIN-specific NEW zero-km dealer advertisements. No exact current production-revision match is verified.

catalogue_decision.count_basis: 19 named configurations: BMW 8 powertrain grades plus 1 promotional equipment package; MINI 10 grade/style/edition configurations. This is not 19 independent battery/drivetrain grades, and is not a whole-market completeness claim.
